verdict.rationale: Kong is an API gateway and management platform whose CLIs (decK, kongctl) automate API lifecycle tasks, so running API tests in CI is a fair question for its APIOps tooling. However, the evidence documents no way to run API test collections or fail a build on test regressions. decK's documented purpose is configuration and lifecycle automation, which is an adjacent capability, not test-collection execution.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my API test collections in CI with a CLI and fail the build on regressions
